simple.meaning: a celebration of thanksgiving for harvest
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to הִלּוּל (H1974) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: הִלּוּל (hillûwl) means a celebration of thanksgiving for harvest First listed occurrence: Judg 9 27.

definitions.short: a celebration of thanksgiving for harvest
definitions.full: H1974. hillul [ הִלּוּל ] noun [masculine] (Late Hebrew id. ) only plural הִלּוּלִים rejoicing, praise : 1 הִלּוּלִים וִיַּעֲשׂוּ Judg 9:27 i.e. a vintage-rejoicing, merry-making, connected with thanksgiving אֱלֹהֵיהֶם בֵּית וַיָּבאֹוּ etc. (i.e. god baal-Berith, see 9:4 ). 2 of praise to ה ׳פקדֶשׁ ׳י, Lev 19:24 (H) holiness of praise , i.e. a consecrated thing in token of thanksgiving for fruit, offered in 4th year (compare Late Hebrew).
